## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `VoidRay-win-x64.exe` |
| Android (most phones), recommended | `VoidRay-android-arm64-v8a.apk` |
| Android (all devices) | `VoidRay-android-universal.apk` |
| Google Play version, for Play Console only (can't be installed directly) | `VoidRay-android-play-store.aab` |

## What's new

- **Android: two versions.** The usual APK stays the one to download: it updates itself from GitHub, like before. The new Google Play version follows Play's rules (updates through Google Play, an explanation before the first connection, encrypted servers only).
- **Android: privacy policy** linked in Settings and on the link screen ([read it](https://github.com/EnderMythex/VOID-RAY/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md)).
- **Android: servers without encryption are marked** "Not encrypted" in the list.
- **Android: "Use another link" now also clears your usage history**, and app data stays out of backups.
- Android: targets Android 16; status bar icons stay visible with the light theme; the slider returns to its place when the connection doesn't start.
- Windows: no change since 1.4.1.
